name: inline-console
description: Shows console.log values and runtime errors inline in the editor, as your code runs.

commands.title: Inline Console: Copy Node Preload Flag

inlineConsole.enabled.description: Capture and display runtime values inline.

inlineConsole.tcpPort.description: TCP port the Node runtime connects to.

inlineConsole.wsPort.description: WebSocket port the browser runtime connects to.

inlineConsole.maxInlineLength.description: Maximum characters shown in the inline value.

inlineConsole.showHitCount.description: Append a hit counter when a line logs more than once.

inlineConsole.autoInjectNodeOptions.description: Automatically add the runtime preload to NODE_OPTIONS in new integrated terminals.

inlineConsole.clearOnSessionStart.description: Clear previous values when a new runtime session connects.

inlineConsole.maxHistoryPerLine.description: How many recent values to retain per source line for the hover view.

inlineConsole.expressionValues.description: Capture the value of every expression, not just console.* calls, so any value can be hovered without adding a log. Rewrites workspace source as it loads; node_modules is never touched. Experimental.

inlineConsole.expressionSampleMs.description: How often captured expression values are sampled and sent, in milliseconds. Higher values cost less in hot loops.

scripts.test: npm run test:equivalence && npm run test:sweep
